title: BI 3802876 (FAP/TRAILR2) Asian Phase 1 in MASH Cirrhosis – China HA Interaction Strategy & Joint Asian Phase 1 Plan (PEC Endorsement Request)

background.text: CV safety findings (hs-cTnT increases of uncertain clinical significance) were identified in studies 1517-0001 SRD Part A and MD Part B in healthy volunteers. Global has initiated Phase 2a (1517-0002) in MASH cirrhosis patients to establish positive benefit/risk before PoC trial. There is uncertainty about China and Japan requiring Asian data before integrating into the next global phase trial. Global confirmed budget for Asian Phase 1 was secured.
background.quote:
CV safety findings were identified in the 1517-0001(SRD, Part A) and (MD, Part B) health volunteer trials.
Before PoC trial, global has initiated a phase 2a in MASH cirrhosis patients to establish a positive benefit/risk profile.
There is uncertainty for China and Japan being requested Asian data before integrating into next phase global trial.
Global confirmed budget for Asian phase 1 was secured.

background.text: BI 3802876 may cause small increases in hs-cTnT of uncertain clinical significance; data from other TRAILR2 agonists suggests hepatotoxicity as a potential risk; absence of Asian data; TDO not available.
background.quote: BI 3802876 may cause small increases in hs-cTnT, which are of uncertain clinical significance at this time.

background.text: Other TRAILR2 agonists suggest hepatotoxicity as a potential associated risk.
background.quote: Data around other TRAILR2 agonists suggests hepatotoxicity as a potential risk associated

background.text: Absence of Asian data is identified as a key factor in the PK backloading assessment.
TDO not available, relevant to exposure in patient assessment.

Asian Phase 1 design: open-label, two dose groups, single dose, MASH cirrhosis population (same as global Phase 2a). 9 patients total: Japan 3+3 pts in DG1&DG2; China skips DG1, 3 pts in DG2. Dose Escalation Committee after 30-day safety observation in DG1.
background.quote:
Trial population: MASH cirrhosis (same as global phase 2a trial)
Trial design: open-label (no placebo), two-dose group cohorts , single dose administration
Participant country: China and Japan (based on HA interaction feedback)
Number of patients: 9pts
Japan : 3pts  + 3pts in Dosing Group 1 &2  (Total: 6 pts)
China: Skip Dosing group 1 , 3pts in Dosing group 2 (Total 3pts)

background.text: Three scenarios for global and Asian timelines: Scenario 1 – both PMDA and CDE request Asian data before Phase 2b (joint Asian Phase 1, FSS~LSO 2027/Mar~2027/Oct); Scenario 2 – PMDA requests Asian data, CDE agrees to PK backloading (China remains in Asian Phase 1 for early data, potential waiver of extensive PK study); Scenario 3 – only CDE requests Asian data (China alone Phase 1, FSS~LSO 2027/Jun~2028/Feb, 4 months behind joint Asian Phase 1).
background.quote:
Scenario 1: Both PMDA and CDE request  Asian data before moving forward to phase 2b.
Scenario 2: PMDA requests Asian data, while CDE agrees to the PK backloading; China will remain involved in the Asian phase 1 to gather early data, potentially allowing for the waiver of an extensive PK study..

background.text: Scenario 3 (China alone Phase 1): completion is 4 months behind joint Asian Phase 1, delaying Chinese enrollment in Phase 2b. Mitigation: include preliminary Phase 1 data at time of CTA submission.
background.quote:
Completion of the China phase 1 is 4 months behind the joint Asan phase 1, which will delay the enrollment of Chinese participants in the phase 2b trial.
The proposed mitigation strategy is to include the preliminary phase 1 data at the time of CTA submission.

background.text: Risk 1: CDE may not agree with limited patient number in Asian Phase 1, particularly DG1 (n=3). Mitigation: emphasize trial is not first-in-human but bridges Asian and Caucasian data; present global data. Risk 2: internal competition of three MASH cirrhosis trials may impact enrollment. Mitigation: prevent overlap in site selection.
background.quote:
Risk : CDE may not agree with the limited patient number of the Asian phase 1 trial, particular in dose group 1 (n=3).

Risk 2:  internal competition of three MASH cirrhosis trial may impact enrollment capability
Mitigation: 1) Emphasize that the trial is not the first human study but seeks to connect data between Asian and Caucasian patients; 2) present global data to reinforce the existing evidence

Mitigation: prevent overlap in site selection

background.text: China not joining DG1 due to very limited window; need to provide strong rationale why only 3 pts for DG1.
background.quote:
China not join DG1 due to the very limited window.
Need to provide strong rationales why only 3 pts for DG1.

background.text: China will submit CTA in parallel with global; snapshot of DG2 safety data to be included in CTA submission.
background.quote: China will submit CTA in parallel with global. Snapshot of DG2 safety data be included in CTA submission.
